verdict.rationale: A server-side session-moderation API is a fair question for a managed realtime media relay, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents an API for creating and managing relays and issuing scoped tokens with expirations. Nothing shows listing active sessions, muting or removing participants, or ending a session server-side; token scoping and expiry are an adjacent access control, not session moderation.

support.subject: As a developer, a server-side API lets me list sessions, mute or remove participants, and end a session without a client in the loop
